_comment: One case file, two implementations: splitstep/db/rallies.py::overlap_fraction and web/src/lib/labels.ts::overlapFraction. Read by tests/test_overlap.py and web/tests/labels.test.ts, the same way score_cases.json is read by both score suites. Every `fraction` was read off the Python function running, not derived by hand. `atLeastHalf` restates the case against the 0.5 gate (STAR_OVERLAP_MIN / SPAN_OVERLAP_MIN) so a drift of a single millisecond at the boundary fails as a boolean, not as a float comparison nobody reads.

cases.name: touching at a's end is not an overlap
touching at a's start is not an overlap
a contains b, so the denominator is b
b contains a, so the denominator is a
exactly half clears the gate, which is >=
one ms under half fails the gate
one ms over half clears the gate
unequal lengths, over the gate on the shorter span
unequal lengths, under the gate on the shorter span
a zero-length span inside another scores 0.0
two zero-length spans at the same instant score 0.0
